descriptor: Yearly activity heatmap with streaks and busiest days

voice.summary: Reports like a clean commit log: numbers first, tone neutral, with a small nod to progress. It never nags and always lets the data make the point.
dos: Lead with the number and the unit, such as 834 contributions in 2025
Use neutral words like streak, busiest and average
Keep tooltips to date plus count

taglines: A year of work, one grid
See the streak, skip the noise
Your busiest day, at a glance
boilerplate: Gridlog is an activity dashboard that turns a year of contributions into a heatmap, with streaks, busiest months and a weekday breakdown.
